mapper.update: UPDATE product_reviews SET rating = #{rating}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id AS memberId, product_id AS productId, rating, title, content, is_published AS isPublished, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM product_reviews WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, member_id AS memberId, product_id AS productId, rating, title, content, is_published AS isPublished, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM product_reviews WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND product_id = #{productId}

SELECT id, member_id AS memberId, product_id AS productId, rating, title, content, is_published AS isPublished, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_published = true ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT #{productId} AS productId, ROUND(AVG(rating)::numeric, 1) AS averageRating, COUNT(id) AS reviewCount FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_published = true

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} AND oi.product_code LIKE CONCAT('P', LPAD(CAST(#{productId} AS VARCHAR), 4, '0'), '%') )
